name: MOSS-Image AI
tagline: Select the words in an image, type new ones, keep the rest of the design
description: MOSS-Image AI is an online image generator for posters, menus, labels, flyers and comics where the words have to be spelled right. Put the exact words in quotes and they come back spelled as typed (English or Chinese). When one word, date or price is wrong, you select that part of the image, type the replacement, and only that text is redrawn, so you don't have to regenerate the whole picture. Layout mode lets you drag boxes to place the headline, price or logo. Runs in the browser, no install. Free trial is a one-time 6 credits (first standard image with no sign-up, +4 after email verification or Google sign-up), then one-time credit packs from $6.99. No subscription.
